This isn't a passive ticket-handling role; you will be the operational backbone for our partner experience—relentlessly removing friction, maintaining bulletproof data integrity, and unblocking partners and internal teams in real time.

The ideal candidate is an execution-focused operator with a bias for action, incredible attention to detail, and a knack for solving complex operational puzzles in a fast-moving environment.

  + Unblock partner access to learning systems, ensuring seamless training and certification pathways.

description:
Job Description
  

Avanade India’s Business Applications practice is looking for a Dynamics 365 CRM Solution Architect to take overall architectural ownership of our CRM projects. This is a senior, functionally led role for someone whose career has been built on Dynamics 365 CRM — who understands how sales, service, marketing and field teams actually work, and can design a CRM solution that fits those processes rather than forcing them to fit the product.

You will lead solution design across the Dynamics 365 customer engagement modules and the Power Platform, run the functional conversation with business stakeholders, and give the technical team a design they can build. The emphasis is on functional depth — process design, fit-gap, configuration-first solutions and adoption — backed by enough technical understanding to make sound decisions on integration, data, security and extension, and to hold the build team to a good standard. The role also carries a strong presales element: you will be the CRM solution lead on pursuits for Dynamics 365 and Power Apps opportunities — shaping the solution, demonstrating it, estimating it and helping us win it.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture for Dynamics 365 CRM projects — from discovery and requirements through design, build, testing, go-live and hypercare.

* Lead business process workshops with client stakeholders, map current and future-state processes, and translate them into a Dynamics 365 solution design.

* Run fit-gap analysis against standard Dynamics 365 capability, favouring configuration over customisation, and make clear recommendations where gaps need Power Platform or custom extension.

* Design functional solutions across the Dynamics 365 customer engagement modules: Sales (lead-to-opportunity, forecasting, sales accelerator), Customer Service and Contact Center (case management, SLAs, entitlements, knowledge, omnichannel routing), Field Service (work orders, scheduling, resources, assets, inventory), Customer Insights – Journeys and Customer Insights – Data (marketing journeys, segmentation, unified customer profile), and Project Operations where project-based selling and delivery are in scope.

* Design the Dataverse data model and security model — tables, relationships, business units, security roles, teams, field-level security and hierarchy security — to match the client’s organisation.

* Design Power Platform extensions: model-driven apps for core CRM processes, canvas apps for task-focused and mobile scenarios, Power Pages portals for customers and partners, and Power Automate for workflow and automation.

* Bring Copilot and AI capabilities into the CRM solution where they add value — Copilot in Sales and Customer Service, Copilot Studio agents and AI-assisted productivity features.

* Define the integration approach with ERP, marketing, telephony, websites and third-party systems — at design level, with the technical team owning detailed build.

* Define data migration strategy from legacy CRM platforms (Salesforce, older Dynamics CRM versions or others) — mapping, cleansing, sequencing and reconciliation.

* Author and own solution design documents, functional specifications, configuration workbooks and architecture decisions, and walk client stakeholders through them.

* Guide functional consultants and developers during build, review configuration and design quality, and resolve functional and architectural escalations.

* Oversee testing strategy with QA and business teams — scenario coverage, UAT support and business sign-off — and support cutover and go-live readiness.

* Set ALM, environment and governance standards with the technical lead — solutions, environments, deployment approach and Power Platform governance.

* Lead presales solutioning for Dynamics 365 CRM and Power Apps opportunities — understanding the client’s business problem, qualifying scope and shaping the right solution from the Dynamics 365 modules and Power Platform components.

* Run presales discovery workshops, business-process walkthroughs and high-level fit-gap to define the solution scope and approach.

* Build and deliver tailored solution demos and proofs of concept on Dynamics 365 and Power Apps, showing the client’s own scenarios rather than generic product tours.

* Prepare solution architecture, scope, assumptions, effort estimates, phasing and team structure for proposals, RFP/RFI responses and statements of work.

* Advise on Dynamics 365 and Power Platform licensing during presales, and position the solution against competing platforms such as Salesforce and ServiceNow.

* Work with sales, bid management, delivery and Microsoft account and partner teams on pursuits, including Microsoft co-sell and funded programmes where applicable.

* Present the solution and delivery approach in client orals and executive presentations, and support negotiation of scope through to contract and handover to delivery.

* Mentor CRM functional consultants and contribute reusable process models, demo assets and accelerators to the practice.

  
Qualification
  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 14–17 years of overall experience, with the substantial majority focused on Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM / Customer Engagement and its predecessor Dynamics CRM versions.

* Deep functional expertise in Dynamics 365 Sales and Dynamics 365 Customer Service, with strong working knowledge of at least one of Field Service, Customer Insights (Journeys / Data), Contact Center or Project Operations.

* Proven experience as solution or functional architect on multiple end-to-end Dynamics 365 CRM implementations, including at least two full lifecycle projects from design to go-live.

* Strong grounding in CRM business processes — lead and opportunity management, account and contact management, quote and order, case management, service scheduling and marketing journeys.

* Demonstrated ability to run discovery and process workshops, lead fit-gap analysis and produce clear solution designs and functional specifications.

* Strong command of the Power Platform: model-driven apps, canvas apps, Power Pages and Power Automate — knowing which to use for which scenario.

* Good understanding of Dataverse — data model, security model, business rules, business process flows and configuration capability.

* Technical implementation understanding sufficient to guide the build team: plug-ins and JavaScript extension points, integration patterns (APIs, connectors, Azure integration services), data migration tooling and ALM — hands-on development is not required.

* Experience designing data migration from legacy CRM platforms and managing data quality through cutover.

* Awareness of Dynamics 365 and Power Platform licensing and how it shapes solution design.

* Strong client-facing skills — credible with sales, service and marketing leaders, and able to defend design decisions with business and IT stakeholders.

* Experience guiding and reviewing the work of functional consultants and developers on medium-to-large projects.

* Solid presales experience for Dynamics 365 CRM and Power Apps based solutions — discovery, solution shaping, demos, estimation and proposal writing — with a track record of contributing to won deals.

* Understanding of the presales lifecycle from qualification through RFP response, orals and negotiation, and of how estimates and assumptions translate into commercial risk.

* Ability to build and deliver compelling Dynamics 365 and Power Platform demos tailored to the client’s industry and processes.

**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Microsoft certifications: Dynamics 365 Customer Experience Analyst (MB-280), Customer Service Functional Consultant (MB-230), Field Service Functional Consultant (MB-240), Power Platform Solution Architect (PL-600) or Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (MB-910).

* Hands-on experience with Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service, and with Copilot Studio agents in a CRM context.

* Experience migrating clients from Salesforce or other CRM platforms to Dynamics 365.

* Experience integrating Dynamics 365 CRM with Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Business Central or SAP.

* Experience with Microsoft FastTrack or Success by Design reviews.

* Industry depth in one or more of BFSI, manufacturing, retail, professional services, healthcare or public sector.

* Exposure to Power BI reporting for CRM and to Customer Insights – Data for customer analytics.

* Experience in a consulting, global delivery or SI environment (Avanade, Accenture, or similar).

* Experience with Microsoft partner motions — co-sell, Microsoft-funded engagements (e.g. Business Applications workshops and envisioning programmes) and joint pursuits with Microsoft account teams.

* Competitive knowledge of Salesforce, ServiceNow and other CRM platforms for positioning and migration pursuits.

title: Senior Enterprise Delivery Manager, Migrations
description:
Overview:
**Working at Atlassian**


Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

 **Why should you apply to this role?**  

The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.  

You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.  

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.


Responsibilities:
* **Migration Strategy:** Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
* **Risk Management**: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* **Technical Architecture:** Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* **Trusted Advisor:** Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* **Delivery Excellence:** Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* **Drive Accountability**: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* **Escalation Management:** Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* **Team Leadership**: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.

**Industry Insight:** Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.


Compensation:

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.


This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.


Qualifications:
* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.

**Benefits \& Perks**  

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits****.**

 **About Atlassian**  

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.  

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. **POSITION: Associate: Customer Experience**

**ABOUT PARIKSHE:**

PARIKSHE is envisioned as a one\-stop learning solution for students preparing for Karnataka State Board examinations. We currently cater to SSLC, PU Science and PU Commerce students through our dedicated YouTube channels and the PARIKSHE App, with a strong focus on accessible, high\-quality and bilingual learning.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Customer Experience Associate will be one of the key points of contact for our paid students after enrollment. The role involves student onboarding, query resolution, feedback collection, student research, and operational coordination. We are looking for someone who is student\-friendly, proactive, and takes complete ownership of tasks from identifying a concern to ensuring its closure.

SKILLS REQUIREMENTS

● Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact confidently and empathetically with students.

● High ownership, follow\-up, and problem\-solving ability.

● Good organizational skills and attention to detail.

● Ability to work with Google Sheets/Excel, trackers, and basic data.

● Analytical mindset to identify recurring student concerns and communicate insights clearly to respective teams.

● Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple internal and external stakeholders.

● Adaptable and willing to take up additional responsibilities based on business requirements.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

● Conduct daily onboarding calls for newly enrolled students, including verification of student/course details, language preferences, app access, and overall onboarding experience.

● Handle student queries and calls, coordinate with relevant teams, and ensure concerns are followed through until closure.

● Conduct regular feedback and research calls with paid users and document meaningful student insights.

● Identify recurring feedback, conduct detailed surveys, and share structured inputs with the Product, Sales, Academic, and Operations teams.

● Coordinate physical book orders, including student address verification, printer/logistics coordination, delivery tracking, and resolution of delayed or failed deliveries.

● Maintain accurate trackers and reports related to onboarding, student queries, feedback, and operations.

● Develop thorough knowledge of PARIKSHE's courses, app, products and processes to confidently guide students.

● Manage student communication portals such as Telegram groups and WhatsApp to enhance student experience.

ELIGIBILITY

Educational Qualification: Graduate in any discipline.

Work Experience: Prior experience in customer/student support, operations, customer success, telecalling, or similar roles is preferred. Strong communication and ownership may take priority over prior experience.

Language: Strong communication in English and Kannada required.

WHY THIS ROLE?

This role provides hands\-on exposure to Student Experience, Operations, Product, Sales, and Customer Research. It is ideal for someone who enjoys interacting with customers, solving problems, taking ownership, and using student feedback to contribute towards improving the overall PARIKSHE experience.

OTHER DETAILS

Employment: Full\-time

Working Days: 6 days per week

title: Senior Analyst
description:
**About the Role**
==================


Rubrik is looking for a detail\-driven Senior Analyst to join our Cloud GTM Operations team, based in India and supporting our APJ and EMEA regions. This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Engineering, our cloud partners (Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud), and our broader alliance and referral partners. It is central to how Rubrik transacts through cloud marketplaces, executes co\-funded growth programs, and runs its partner and co\-sell motions.


You will own the end\-to\-end creation and delivery of Marketplace Private Offers across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud — supporting customers and partners through the purchase process — and drive the operational execution of Cloud Funding programs, from deal submission and spend tracking to flagging risks, following up with Account Executives, and standing up new programs. You will also manage day\-to\-day alliances and partner operations, including co\-sell activity in Clazar, deal registrations, alliances reporting, and partner programs such as the Okta referral program.


It is a high\-visibility, process\-oriented role for someone who thrives on accuracy, follow\-through, and keeping many moving parts in sync across time zones and stakeholders.  

  

  



**Key Responsibilities**
========================


**Marketplace Private Offers (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)**


* Create, configure, and publish Private Offers across the Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud marketplaces, ensuring pricing, terms, and durations match approved deal parameters.
* Serve as the operational point of contact for marketplace transactions supporting AEs across the APJ and EMEA territories.
* Validate offer details against Salesforce opportunities and quotes, and coordinate corrections before offers are extended to customers.
* Track offer status through acceptance and closure, proactively resolving issues that could delay a deal.
* Maintain accurate records of all Private Offers and connect them to booking workflows.

**Cloud Funding Program Execution**


* Submit qualifying deals into cloud partner funding programs (e.g., Microsoft, AWS, and Google co\-funding / incentive programs) accurately and on time.
* Track funding spend against approved budgets, monitor utilization, and maintain a clear, current view of program balances.
* Raise flags early on at\-risk claims, expiring funds, missing documentation, or approvals that are stalling.
* Follow up persistently with Account Executives/BDMs to gather deal details, documentation, and approvals needed to progress and claim funding.
* Help design and stand up new funding programs — defining process, eligibility criteria, intake, and tracking mechanisms in partnership with stakeholders.

**Cross\-Functional Partnership**


* Work with Finance on budget alignment, accruals, spend reconciliation, and claim payouts.
* Partner with Engineering / Systems teams to improve tooling, automation, and reporting for marketplace and funding workflows.
* Collaborate with Sales and Account Executives to keep deals moving and ensure operational requirements are met.
* Coordinate with cloud partner Business Development Managers (BDMs) to align on program rules, approvals, and escalations.
* Produce regular status reporting and dashboards on offer volume, funding utilization, and program health for leadership.

**Alliances \& Partner Operations**


* Manage co\-sell activity in Clazar — including ad hoc opportunity sharing, partner introductions, deal updates, and deal registrations.
* Run alliances activity reporting, tracking the agreed process and metrics for partner engagement and pipeline.
* Manage the Okta referral program end to end.
* Handle Salesforce partnership deal registration.

 Monitor Sophos orders and manage related invoicing on an ad hoc basis.  
* 

**Success Metrics**
===================


* Private Offers created accurately and within agreed turnaround times (SLA adherence).
* Funding submitted, tracked, and claimed with minimal leakage or expired funds.
* Timely, reliable flagging of risks and clean, audit\-ready records.
* Responsive, trusted partnership across Sales, Finance, Engineering, and cloud BDMs.
* New or improved funding programs launched with clear, repeatable processes.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================


* 2–4 years of experience in sales operations, deal desk, revenue operations, alliances/partner operations, or a comparable analytical/operations role.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud marketplaces (Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud) and/or Private Offer creation — or a demonstrated ability to learn these workflows quickly.
* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce (CRM) and comfort operating across quoting, opportunity, and reporting workflows.
* Advanced spreadsheet skills (Excel / Google Sheets) for tracking spend, reconciling data, and building reports.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a track record of accurate, on\-time execution under deadline pressure.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to follow up with and hold stakeholders accountable.
* Ability to work across APJ and EMEA time zones and juggle multiple priorities and stakeholders simultaneously.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================


* Direct experience administering or executing cloud partner funding / co\-investment programs (Microsoft, AWS, or Google).
* Familiarity with the mechanics of cloud marketplace transactions and marketplace billing / booking flows.
* Experience partnering with Finance on accruals, budget tracking, and reconciliation.
* Exposure to designing or improving operational processes and tooling in a fast\-scaling SaaS or cloud company.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field.

title: Bid Management Consultant
description:
Job Description
  
**Role Summary**

  

Avanade India is looking for a Pre\-Sales Bid Manager to run our pursuits from first qualification to signed contract. This is the person who owns the bid — the plan, the calendar, the win themes, the response, the pricing inputs and the stakeholders — so that solution architects and sales leaders can focus on the client and the solution while the bid itself runs on time and to a high standard.


You will manage multiple RFPs, RFIs and proactive proposals at once, working across sales, solution architects, delivery, finance, legal, Microsoft and partner teams. We expect you to use Gen AI tools as a core part of how you work — to analyse RFPs, draft and reuse content, check compliance and produce stronger responses in less time — and to bring that way of working to the teams around you. Knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem is a significant advantage, as most of our pursuits are built on it.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own end\-to\-end bid management for assigned pursuits — from lead qualification and bid/no\-bid decision through response, orals, negotiation support and deal closure.
* Run the bid qualification process: gather opportunity intelligence, assess fit and win probability, and prepare the bid/no\-bid case for leadership.
* Build and run the bid plan — timelines, owners, review gates, internal deadlines and a clear RACI across contributors.
* Analyse RFPs and RFIs in detail — requirements, evaluation criteria, commercial and contractual terms — and maintain the compliance matrix and clarification log.
* Define win themes, value propositions and differentiators with sales and solution leads, and make sure they run through every section of the response.
* Coordinate solution architects, delivery leads and subject\-matter experts to produce the solution, approach, plan, team structure and assumptions on time.
* Work with finance and the deal team on price modelling — effort and resource\-based pricing, fixed price, time and materials, managed services and outcome\-based models — including rate cards, margin, contingency and commercial assumptions.
* Manage risk, legal and contractual review with legal, compliance and delivery assurance teams, including deviations, terms and risk registers.
* Use Gen AI tools across the bid lifecycle — RFP summarisation and requirement extraction, first\-draft generation, content reuse from the proposal library, compliance checking, editing and consistency review — while owning the accuracy and quality of what goes out.
* Build and maintain a reusable proposal content library — case studies, credentials, CVs, boilerplate and approach sections — structured so both people and AI tools can use it well.
* Engage external stakeholders — clients, Microsoft account and partner teams, third\-party partners and subcontractors — for clarifications, joint positioning, co\-sell and partner inputs.
* Produce the final response to a high standard — structure, writing, formatting, graphics and executive summary — and run the quality reviews (pink, red and gold team or equivalent) before submission.
* Prepare the team for orals, demos and clarification meetings — storyboards, presentation decks, rehearsals and Q\&A preparation.
* Support negotiation and closure — BAFO responses, commercial revisions, SOW and contract finalisation — through to handover into delivery.
* Track pursuit pipeline, status and outcomes in CRM, run win/loss reviews, and feed lessons learned back into the bid process and content library.

  
Qualification
  
* 8–12 years of experience in IT services, with at least 5 years in bid management, proposal management or pre\-sales.
* Proven end\-to\-end bid management experience — owning complex RFP/RFI responses and proactive proposals from qualification through to closure.
* Clear understanding of the full pre\-sales lifecycle: lead, qualification, bid/no\-bid, solutioning, pricing, response, orals, negotiation, contracting and handover to delivery.
* Hands\-on use of Gen AI tools (for example Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or proposal tools such as Loopio, Responsive or Qvidian with AI features) to improve bid productivity, with a clear view of where they help and where human review is essential.
* Working understanding of price modelling in IT services — pricing constructs, rate cards, effort\-based pricing, margin, contingency and commercial risk — and the ability to work with finance on the deal model.
* Proven ability to coordinate internal stakeholders across sales, solutioning, delivery, finance and legal, and external stakeholders including clients, partners and vendors.
* Strong skills in RFP analysis, compliance management, bid planning and running review gates to deadline.
* Excellent business writing and editing — able to turn technical input into a clear, persuasive, client\-focused response and executive summary.
* Strong presentation skills in PowerPoint, Word and Excel, and comfort producing polished proposal documents under time pressure.
* Ability to manage several concurrent bids, prioritise effectively and hold contributors to commitments without direct authority.

Good understanding of IT services offerings — application development, cloud, data, AI, business applications and managed services.  

* 

  

**Preferred / Good to Have**

  

* Knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem and technologies — Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft 365, Fabric and Copilot — and how they are positioned and sold.
* Experience with Microsoft partner programmes and motions — co\-sell, Microsoft funding and incentive programmes, and partner solution positioning.
* Experience in a Microsoft partner, consulting, global delivery or SI environment (Avanade, Accenture, or similar).
* Bid or proposal management certification — APMP Foundation or Practitioner, or equivalent.
* Experience with CRM and pursuit tracking tools such as Dynamics 365 Sales or Salesforce.
* Experience building AI\-assisted bid processes — prompt libraries, Copilot agents or automated content retrieval for proposal teams.
* Experience with public sector, BFSI or large enterprise procurement processes and formal tenders.
* Graphic or visual storytelling skills for proposals and orals.
* Experience with pursuits across India and the wider APAC region.

title: Sales Operations
description:
Job Purpose

To manage and monitor the day\-to\-day sales operations of the team, ensure proper follow\-up on enquiries and quotations, track individual and team performance, maintain sales discipline, and coordinate with internal departments to achieve sales targets.

Key Responsibilities / KRA1\. Team Monitoring \& Coordination

* Monitor the daily activities of Sales Executives/BDEs.
* Ensure team members follow their daily calling, customer visit and follow\-up plans.
* Allocate and monitor leads/enquiries among team members.
* Review pending activities and ensure timely completion.
* Guide team members on follow\-up priorities and sales processes.

2\. Sales Target Monitoring

* Track individual and team\-wise monthly sales targets.
* Monitor daily/weekly achievement against targets.
* Identify gaps in performance and communicate corrective action.
* Follow up with team members on pending targets and opportunities.
* Prepare target vs. achievement reports for management.

3\. Enquiry \& Lead Management

* Monitor all incoming enquiries and ensure proper allocation.
* Check whether enquiries are being contacted and followed up on time.
* Track enquiry status from **lead → appointment → quotation → follow\-up → order**.
* Identify inactive or unattended leads and take corrective action.
* Ensure proper lead verification and data entry.

4\. Quotation \& Follow\-up Monitoring

* Monitor all quotations generated by the sales team.
* Ensure timely follow\-up on pending quotations.
* Track quotation\-to\-order conversion.
* Identify lost quotations and record reasons wherever possible.
* Escalate important or high\-value opportunities to the Sales Manager.

5\. Daily Sales Review

* Conduct/coordinate daily sales updates from team members.
* Review calls, visits, enquiries, quotations and orders.
* Maintain a daily activity tracker.
* Identify important pending cases requiring management intervention.
* Ensure sales team members maintain proper CRM/ERP updates.

6\. MIS \& Reporting

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly sales MIS.
* Prepare individual sales\-performance reports.
* Maintain enquiry, quotation, order and conversion reports.
* Prepare pending follow\-up and ageing reports.
* Share regular reports with the Sales Manager/Sales Head.

7\. Sales Team Support

* Support Sales Executives/BDEs with customer information, order history, pricing and internal coordination.
* Help team members resolve routine sales\-related issues.
* Coordinate with management for special pricing, approvals and exceptional customer requirements.
* Support new team members in understanding sales processes.

8\. Interdepartmental Coordination

* Coordinate with Accounts, Production, Stores, Dispatch and other departments for sales requirements.
* Track order status and communicate delays to the concerned salesperson.
* Ensure customer commitments are properly communicated internally.
* Follow up on pending orders, dispatches and payment\-related issues.

9\. Customer \& Order Monitoring

* Monitor important customer orders and pending requirements.
* Track repeat orders and potential business opportunities.
* Ensure customer complaints or operational issues are escalated and followed up.
* Coordinate with the concerned sales person for customer retention and repeat business.

10\. Team Discipline \& Process Compliance

* Ensure team members follow company sales procedures.
* Monitor attendance, reporting, daily activity and CRM updates where applicable.
* Ensure timely submission of reports.
* Identify repeated gaps in performance, follow\-up or reporting and report them to the Sales Manager.

11\. Performance Review Support

* Maintain performance records of individual team members.
* Identify high performers and employees requiring additional support.
* Provide regular performance feedback to team members.

title: Post-Sales Operations Executive
description:
**Job Description: Post\-Sales Operations Executive**Hiring \| BoxUp Luxury Gifting**Post\-Sales Operations Executive**Department: Post\-Sales Operations / Customer ExperienceExperience: 2–3 YearsLocation: BengaluruEmployment Type: Full\-timeReporting To: Post\-Sales Operations Lead / Head of Operations**About BoxUp**BoxUp Luxury Gifting is a corporate gifting and personalised gifting company focused on creating meaningful experiences through thoughtful products, customised packaging, and seamless fulfilment.We work with leading corporates and businesses to deliver customised gifting solutions, managing everything from product selection and branding to packaging and delivery.As we continue to scale our operations, we are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented Post\-Sales Operations Executive to ensure a smooth and exceptional customer experience after every confirmed order.**Role Overview**The Post\-Sales Operations Executive will be responsible for managing the complete order execution process once a sale has been confirmed by the sales team and a job card has been created.The individual will serve as the primary coordination point between customers and internal departments, ensuring that every order progresses seamlessly through mockup approvals, procurement, production, quality checks, dispatch, and final delivery.This role requires strong ownership, excellent communication, effective follow\-up skills, and the ability to manage multiple orders simultaneously while ensuring customer satisfaction and timely execution.The objective is simple: Once the sales team closes an order, the Post\-Sales Operations Executive takes ownership of its execution until successful delivery and customer feedback.**Key Responsibilities1\. Job Card Review \& Order Handover**

* Review job cards received from the sales team after order confirmation.
* Understand customer requirements, product specifications, quantities, branding, packaging, delivery locations, and committed timelines.
* Identify missing information or discrepancies and coordinate with the sales team for clarification.
* Ensure all relevant documents, approvals, and customer commitments are properly recorded.
* Prepare an execution plan and initiate the order workflow.
* Take complete ownership of the order after the handover.

**2\. Internal Department Coordination**

* Coordinate with the mockup and design team for artwork, branding layouts, and sample preparation.
* Follow up with the procurement team to ensure timely sourcing and availability of products and materials.
* Work closely with printing and production teams to ensure execution as per approved specifications.
* Coordinate with quality control to ensure products meet the required standards.
* Liaise with the warehouse team for packing, inventory readiness, and dispatch preparation.
* Ensure all departments are aligned on timelines and deliverables.
* Proactively follow up to prevent delays and resolve operational bottlenecks.

**3\. Customer Communication \& Servicing**

* Act as the primary point of contact for customers after order confirmation.
* Share regular updates on order progress and expected delivery timelines.
* Coordinate with customers to obtain mockup, artwork, and sample approvals.
* Ensure customer approvals are documented before proceeding with production.
* Address customer queries and concerns promptly and professionally.
* Communicate any changes, delays, or challenges transparently.
* Build strong customer relationships through proactive communication and reliable execution.
* Maintain a customer\-first approach throughout the order lifecycle.

**4\. Order Tracking \& Timeline Management**

* Maintain and update the centralised order tracking sheet or CRM.
* Monitor every order against committed timelines.
* Track critical milestones, including mockup approval, procurement, production, quality checks, packing, dispatch, and delivery.
* Ensure no order is left unattended or without a clear next action.
* Identify potential delays in advance and take corrective action.
* Escalate issues to the relevant team or reporting manager when required.
* Ensure timely closure of pending activities.

**5\. Dispatch \& Delivery Management**

* Coordinate with logistics and warehouse teams to ensure timely dispatch.
* Verify shipping addresses, quantities, labels, invoices, and other dispatch documentation.
* Track shipments until successful delivery.
* Follow up with courier partners in case of delays or delivery issues.
* Obtain proof of delivery wherever applicable.
* Keep customers informed about dispatch and delivery status.
* Ensure all delivery commitments are met and documented.

**6\. Complaint \& Issue Resolution**

* Take ownership of customer complaints related to damaged products, missing items, incorrect branding, or delivery delays.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to investigate and resolve issues.
* Ensure complaints are acknowledged and addressed within defined SLAs.
* Maintain clear communication with customers until closure.
* Document complaints and resolutions for future reference.
* Identify recurring issues and share improvement suggestions with the team.

**7\. Customer Satisfaction \& Relationship Building**

* Collect customer feedback after successful delivery.
* Encourage customers to share ratings, reviews, and testimonials.
* Ensure a positive experience at every stage of order execution.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business and refer them to the sales team.
* Share customer feedback and improvement opportunities with management.
* Contribute towards improving customer retention and long\-term relationships.

**8\. Reporting \& Process Compliance**

* Prepare daily and weekly updates on active orders, pending approvals, delayed orders, and upcoming deliveries.
* Maintain accurate records of job cards, customer approvals, communications, and delivery documents.
* Follow established SOPs and operational workflows.
* Highlight recurring execution challenges and suggest process improvements.
* Collaborate with sales and operations teams to improve the order handover process.
* Ensure timely and accurate updates in the designated CRM or order management system.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Operations, or a related field.
* 2–3 years of experience in post\-sales operations, order management, customer servicing, fulfilment, or operations coordination.
* Experience in corporate gifting, customised products, printing, manufacturing, or e\-commerce fulfilment will be an added advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong coordination, follow\-up, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Good planning and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple orders and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong problem\-solving and issue\-resolution capabilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and CRM systems.
* High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Customer\-centric mindset with a proactive and solution\-oriented approach.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**\|  
KPI\|Measurement\|  
\| \-\-\- \| \-\-\- \|  
\|On\-time delivery\|Percentage of orders delivered within committed timelines\|  
\|Order execution TAT\|Time taken to complete orders against agreed timelines\|  
\|Mockup approval TAT\|Time taken to obtain customer approvals\|  
\|Customer satisfaction\|Customer ratings and feedback\|  
\|Complaint resolution TAT\|Time taken to resolve customer complaints\|  
\|Order accuracy\|Percentage of orders delivered without errors\|  
\|Communication efficiency\|Timely customer updates and follow\-ups\|  
\|Documentation accuracy\|Completeness of job cards, approvals, and delivery records\|  
\|Escalation management\|Timely identification and resolution of operational issues\|  
\|Customer retention support\|Repeat\-order opportunities identified and referred to sales\|**What We Expect From You**

* Take ownership of every assigned order from job card creation to final delivery.
* Be proactive rather than waiting for customers or departments to follow up.
* Anticipate potential challenges and work towards resolving them before they become escalations.
* Maintain complete visibility of all active orders.
* Ensure clear communication between customers and internal teams.
* Be accountable for commitments made to customers.
* Maintain a high standard of accuracy, professionalism, and customer service.
* Work collaboratively with the sales team while ensuring a smooth transition from sales to execution.
* Contribute towards building a scalable and process\-driven post\-sales function at BoxUp.

The BoxUp WayWe believe customer experience is not limited to closing a sale. It is defined by how well we deliver on our promises.We are looking for someone who takes ownership, pays attention to details, brings solutions instead of problems, and genuinely cares about creating a great experience for every customer.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


About Amazon Business  

  

Join Amazon Business, where we're revolutionizing B2B commerce. As a rapidly growing $50 billion global business, we're building a future where businesses of all sizes can find, discover, and purchase everything they need with unprecedented ease and intelligence. Our mission: to become the world's most customer\-centric company and the preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. From solo entrepreneurs to Fortune 500 companies, we serve diverse business customers across nine countries, reimagining procurement with innovative solutions that drive efficiency and growth.  

  

At Amazon Business, it's still Day 1\. If you're passionate about solving complex challenges, creating disruptive solutions, and making history, this is your opportunity. Bring your insight, imagination, and healthy disregard for the impossible as we unlock the vast potential of B2B commerce in India.  

  

About the Role:  

Amazon Business is seeking an enterprising, results\-driven Enterprise Sales Manager to lead and scale our enterprise customer acquisition across India. This is a pivotal, end\-to\-end ownership role: the incumbent will be responsible for driving B2B business growth by building deep client relationships, generating and managing a healthy sales pipeline, and orchestrating operations to ensure seamless, end\-to\-end delivery of every business requirement.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

1\) Drive B2B revenue growth — own the enterprise acquisition charter for India, converting strategic target accounts into long\-term, high\-value business relationships and delivering measurable topline and ROI.  

2\) Lead client engagement — act as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for enterprise customers, engaging continuously with key stakeholders and C\-suite decision\-makers to understand their procurement needs and position Amazon Business as their preferred strategic partner.  

3\) Build and manage the pipeline — proactively prospect, qualify, and nurture a robust B2B opportunity pipeline; forecast accurately and manage deals through every stage from lead to closure.  

4\) Own end\-to\-end delivery — manage operations across the deal lifecycle to ensure that committed business requirements are fulfilled on time and in full, coordinating cross\-functionally so that what is sold is reliably delivered.  

5\) Establish scalable operating models — design and implement repeatable, automation\- and AI\-powered operating processes that allow enterprise engagement to scale efficiently without linear headcount growth.  

6\) Negotiate and structure deals — lead commercial negotiations, pricing, custom offers, and contracting (including ARC/rate agreements and terms) to close mutually beneficial, sustainable agreements.  

7\) Drive measurable ROI and account growth — track account health, adoption, wallet share, and spend migration; identify cross\-sell and up\-sell opportunities to expand share of wallet within each enterprise account.  

8\) Collaborate cross\-functionally — partner with category, pricing, operations, fulfillment, finance/credit, product, and marketing teams to remove blockers and deliver a seamless customer experience.  

9\) Leverage data and insights — use data, market intelligence, and competitive analysis to inform account strategy, prioritize opportunities, and continuously improve conversion and delivery outcomes.  

10\) Ensure governance and compliance — maintain accurate CRM hygiene, adhere to internal controls and compliance requirements, and provide clear reporting and business reviews to leadership.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* 4\+ years of sales experience
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience meeting revenue targets and quotas
* Experience in e\-commerce
* Experience working in a fast\-paced and highly cross\-functional organization

title: Director, Cardiac Market Development, Asia
description:
**Company Description** **Primary Function of Position**


Intuitive Surgical is widely considered the most exciting medical device company in the world today. Surgeons worldwide are changing the way surgery is performed by utilizing our robotic surgical device, the ***da Vinci®*** Surgical System, to enhance their surgical precision and greatly improve patient benefits. The Clinical Sales Representative will help maximize the utilization of installed ***da Vinci®*** Surgical Systems.  



  

  

**Job Description**  

The Director, Cardiac Market Development, Asia is an individual contributor role that supports the Cardiac Sales Directors in China, India, Japan, Korea, and Taiwan by translating global cardiac procedure and product strategies into market\-ready plans, programs, and tools. This role also serves as the Asia\-based implementation partner to the Vice President, Global Cardiac, helping bring key global programs, training processes, and global KOL development initiatives to life across Markets with different customer needs, operating models, and development stages.

  

Working closely with the Cardiac Sales Directors in each Market and the VP, Global Cardiac, this role localizes global programs and content, supports training and KOL development execution, tracks performance metrics, and improves quality and matrix efficiency. Commercial priorities and Market\-level decisions remain with the Cardiac Sales Directors and Asia Market General Managers; this role is accountable for enabling and accelerating their execution.

 **Roles \& Responsibilities:**

***Regional Procedure and Product Lifecycle Strategy***

* Support the Cardiac Sales Directors and VP, Global Cardiac in developing and executing cardiac procedure strategies using Market insights, customer needs, competitive dynamics, clinical pathways, and commercial priorities.
* Translate global portfolio, product launch, lifecycle, and procedure strategies into focused roadmaps, priorities, and activation plans.
* Coordinate with sales, clinical, capital, key accounts, customer training, marketing, market access, regulatory, and enabling functions to support readiness, sequencing, and execution.
* Identify adoption barriers, unmet needs, and growth opportunities and convert them into recommendations and action plans for the Cardiac Sales Directors and VP, Global Cardiac.
* Provide structured feedback to global teams on Asia Market requirements, customer needs, evidence gaps, positioning, and future portfolio opportunities.

***Market Development and Marketing Localization***

* Localize cardiac marketing programs, value propositions, messaging, content, media, and field tools while maintaining brand, clinical, regulatory, and legal requirements.
* Develop integrated market development plans spanning segmentation, account activation, peer education, society engagement, digital channels, and stakeholder awareness.
* Enable teams to build sustainable programs with surgeons, care teams, hospital leaders, key opinion leaders, training centers, and reference sites.
* Ensure content and media plans are insight\-led, audience\-specific, reusable, and aligned to the customer journey and sales execution needs.
* Capture, codify, and scale effective practices and share Asia Market learnings with the VP, Global Cardiac, and other Global partners.

***Program Support, Metrics, and Operating Cadence***

* Support the operating rhythm for cardiac Market development and marketing, including annual planning, quarterly business reviews, initiative tracking, and performance reporting.
* Define leading and lagging indicators for program effectiveness, adoption progress, launch readiness, content utilization, and return on investment.
* Create dashboards and decision forums that help leaders assess progress, resolve barriers, redirect low\-value work, and scale successful programs.
* Support initiative portfolio tracking by clarifying owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, and expected outcomes.
* Support budget planning, tracking, and forecasting for cardiac Market development and marketing programs, in partnership with the Cardiac Sales Directors and VP, Global Cardiac.

***Quality, Process, and Matrix Effectiveness***

* Design scalable processes, standards, and ways of working that increase execution quality, speed, consistency, and accountability.
* Clarify interfaces and handoffs across Global, Regional, and local Market teams to reduce duplication, close gaps, and improve matrix efficiency.
* Establish quality controls for plans, programs, content, metrics, and launch deliverables, so work is compliant, decision\-ready, and fit for use.
* Facilitate cross\-functional problem\-solving and remove barriers that limit field execution or customer impact.
* Contribute to a culture of disciplined experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement using data and field feedback.

***Partnership and Collaboration***

* Serve as a close working partner to the Cardiac Sales Directors in each Market on execution of growth priorities, programs, and training, with Market commercial decisions remaining with the Sales Directors and Asia Market General Managers.
* Partner with Market and Regional teams across China, India, Japan, Korea, and Taiwan to drive alignment through influence and collaboration rather than direct authority.
* Build regional learning loops that allow Market teams to adapt programs locally while scaling effective practices across Asia.
* Act as the Asia\-based point of contact for the VP, Global Cardiac on implementation of key global programs, training curricula, and global KOL development initiatives.
* Communicate progress, insights, and performance clearly to the Cardiac Sales Directors, VP, Global Cardiac, and Asia leadership.

  

**Qualifications** **Skills, Experience, Education, \& Training:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, life sciences, healthcare, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* 8\+ years of progressive experience in medical devices, healthcare, or another complex regulated industry, including experience in sales, marketing, market development, or commercial operations.
* Demonstrated success translating global strategies into Market\-specific commercial plans and measurable execution.
* Experience with procedure development, product launch and lifecycle management, customer segmentation, integrated marketing, and commercial planning.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including budget tracking, forecasting support, and performance management.
* Proven ability to lead through influence across countries, functions, and organizational levels in a complex matrix.
* Advanced analytical capability, including defining metrics, leading operating reviews, interpreting results, and turning insights into decisions.
* Strong process design, program management, and continuous improvement capability.
* Executive\-level communication and presentation skills across clinical, technical, financial, and commercial audiences.
* Cardiac surgery, cardiovascular, robotic\-assisted surgery, or related clinical\-commercial experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting or delivering global training curricula, surgeon proctoring or mentoring programs, or key opinion leader (KOL) development initiatives is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated cross\-cultural agility and experience supporting multiple Asia Markets.
* Must live in Singapore, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, or India and be able to travel internationally as needed; expected travel of 30\-40%.
* This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports; success depends on influence, collaboration, and execution excellence rather than formal authority.
* English fluency is required; proficiency in Mandarin, Japanese, or Korean is a plus.

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID\-19\. Details can vary by role.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The APJ Innovation and Engagement team is the pulse of innovation for AWS in the region. We design and deliver innovation experiences that bring Amazon's culture and technology to life — helping senior executives reimagine what's possible and chart a path from idea to production. Beyond delivery, we shape innovation strategy for APJ: identifying emerging technology trends, understanding how they intersect with customer needs across diverse markets, and translating that into experiences that drive real business outcomes. Our team works across 14 countries spanning vastly different industries, stages of cloud maturity, and competitive landscapes. We partner closely with field sales, solutions architecture, and specialist teams to activate customers and ensure every engagement moves the needle. We are builders at heart — constantly evolving our content, mechanisms, and delivery models to stay ahead of the pace of change in AI and technology innovation. We're looking for a customer\-obsessed Innovation Program Lead to drive customer impact through our innovation experiences — using Amazon culture and technology to help enterprise customers discover, invent, and build their way to production. This role is about delivering tangible business outcomes, helping customers realize value from their technology and AI investments by combining the best of how Amazon innovates with the power of AWS technology. You'll facilitate executive engagements, activate customers in partnership with field sales teams, build scalable mechanisms across our top customers, and lead the development of next\-generation content. The nature of innovation is ever\-changing, and this role requires someone who is deeply adaptable and energized by that pace of change.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

1\. Customer Impact through Business, Technology \& Culture Transformation  

Lead and facilitate executive\-level innovation sessions that bring Amazon's culture of innovation — Working Backwards, customer obsession, bias for action — to life for customers. Create an environment where senior leaders engage deeply with new possibilities and leave with clear business outcomes in mind.  

Apply first\-principles thinking to understand customers' most pressing challenges and translate those into actionable AI\-driven solution pathways. Help customers adopt Amazon's innovation methods alongside AWS technology to drive real business results.  

Own the customer journey beyond the engagement — work closely with field sales teams to activate customers, drive solution adoption, and accelerate the path from idea to measurable business outcomes in production.  

2\. Mechanisms \& Operational Excellence  

Design and implement scalable engagement frameworks. Leverage AI to streamline processes — from session preparation to insight capture — ensuring every customer interaction generates reusable learnings.  

Build the ability to scale innovation experiences across our top customers in the region, ensuring consistent quality and impact at volume while delivering business outcomes.  

Build strong operating interlocks with field sales teams, solutions architects, and partner organizations. Establish a clear operating model that makes it frictionless for account teams to activate customers into innovation experiences.  

Codify what works. Develop playbooks, templates, and tooling that enable other markets to replicate successful engagement patterns as the model expands across the region.  

3\. Content Leadership  

Build next\-generation content modules focused on generative AI, agentic systems, and applied AI — grounded in Amazon's culture of innovation and maintained as a portfolio that is modular, industry\-adaptable, and technically current.  

Elevate the delivery experience — integrate AI to personalize content in real\-time, generate dynamic demonstrations, and create immersive customer experiences that bring Amazon culture and technology together in a way that sets us apart in the region.  

The nature of innovation is ever\-changing. Maintain a forward\-looking content roadmap, monitor industry signals, competitive moves, and customer patterns — and adapt quickly to ensure our offerings remain relevant as technology evolves.

* 6\+ years of Go\-To\-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
* Experience presenting to both technical and non\-technical executive audiences
* Strong first\-principles problem\-solving ability — comfortable deconstructing ambiguous customer challenges into clear action plans that deliver business outcomes
* Strong ability to apply AI/ML capabilities to solve business problems and drive transformation outcomes, engaging both technical and business audiences on generative AI, agentic systems, and applied AI

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience operating across APJ markets with sensitivity to regional and cultural nuances

* Passion for Amazon's culture of innovation and ability to translate it into customer\-facing experiences
* Hands\-on experience applying AI tools to business problems and customer engagement workflows

 **Responsibilities**  

People Management  



  

Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.

  

Model \- Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.

  

Coach \- Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.

  

Care \- Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

  

Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment

  

Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes, and ensures that proposed solutions are aligned with broader organizational strategy. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.

  

Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Advises team on managing changes and facilitating feedback. Uses broad patterns of feedback to develop strategic and actionable insights and presents a compelling business case to program managers that influences product roadmaps and decision making. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.

  

Drives internal advocacy by facilitating insight sharing with Product Engineering teams, and providing guidance through escalation, acceleration, and prioritization. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. Mentors peers and teams on best practices around internal resources usage. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.

  

Architecture Design and Deployment

  

Holds teams accountable for leveraging existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft's agreed commitments to the customer/partner and developing new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners and markets. When appropriate, governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.

  

Guides team in defining and documenting the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix. Ensures team is equipped to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Guides team in cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Promotes a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. Provides coaching to allow architects to scale solutions. Support new customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft, as needed.

  

Collaborates with the other managers to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. Provides end\-to\-end governance, oversight, and thought leadership within assigned account. Provides guidance to team in understanding and demonstrating business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.

  

Guides team in working with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Supports team in managing and resolving highly complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Ensures maintenance of the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Oversees development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer.

  

Leads team in collaborating to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Ensures team builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex solution approach. Provides thought leadership on oversight and governance sets expectations for quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Promotes a cohesive build methodology so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams. When appropriate, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes. Challenges deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on regular cadence, as needed. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. Innovates and implements long\-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio, as needed. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.

  

Creates a culture and clarity around technical insights and escalations, and ensures broad sets of projects move forward. Provides support and guidance to team in identifying scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. At Avanade, we help organizations see the future faster then actually build it. Our Advisory \& Experience practice sits at the intersection of Digital **strategy, experience, and AI** , working with governments, banks, healthcare systems, airports, and global brands across Southeast Asia.

This India\-based leadership position is locally focused but truly **part of a regional/global team** – you will co\-create with experts across Southeast Asia and worldwide, bringing the best of Avanade’s global expertise to solve local client challenges.


If you are a visionary consultant with 10–12\+ years’ experience in digital strategy and technology\-led change, excited to work in a high\-impact, collaborative environment, we invite you to join us in **transforming businesses and customer experiences** in the India

Also, exposure to other cloud and data platforms such as Google, AWS could be beneficial.

* Collaborative leader who raises the bar for others.

title: Area Sales Manager (ASM)
description:
**About Ignite**

At **Ignite**, we're passionate about transforming fitness spaces with innovative, high\-performance gym equipment designed for commercial and professional environments.

From boutique fitness studios and premium gyms to educational institutions, hotels, corporate wellness centres, and sports facilities, we help our customers create spaces that inspire healthier lifestyles and exceptional fitness experiences.

As we continue to expand across India, we're looking for ambitious professionals who share our passion for fitness, customer success, and business growth.

**About the Role**

As an **Area Sales Manager**, you will be responsible for driving business growth across your assigned territory by building strong relationships with gym owners, fitness entrepreneurs, distributors, educational institutions, hospitality businesses, and corporate clients.

This is a consultative sales role where success comes from understanding customer requirements, identifying business opportunities, and recommending the right fitness equipment solutions.

You'll represent the Ignite brand in your region while contributing to our mission of making world\-class fitness solutions more accessible across India.

**What You'll DoBusiness Development**

* Drive sales growth across your assigned territory by identifying and developing new business opportunities.
* Build and manage relationships with gym owners, fitness chains, educational institutions, corporate clients, hotels, and sports facilities.
* Generate new business through prospecting, networking, referrals, and market development activities.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets while maintaining healthy business margins.

**Customer Engagement**

* Understand customer requirements and recommend tailored fitness equipment solutions.
* Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, and site visits.
* Build long\-term relationships by delivering an exceptional customer experience throughout the sales journey.
* Provide post\-sales support by coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely installations and customer satisfaction.

**Market Development**

* Expand Ignite's brand presence within the assigned territory.
* Develop partnerships with architects, interior designers, consultants, fitness influencers, and industry professionals.
* Represent Ignite at fitness expos, networking events, and industry exhibitions.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and emerging business opportunities.

**Business Excellence**

* Maintain an active sales pipeline and accurate CRM records.
* Prepare sales forecasts and business reports.
* Collaborate with marketing, operations, and service teams to ensure seamless project execution.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business and customer referrals.

**Who We're Looking For**

We're looking for professionals who are passionate about sales, enjoy building relationships, and have a genuine interest in the fitness and wellness industry.

You should have:

* 3–6 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or channel sales.
* Experience in fitness equipment, sports goods, wellness, healthcare, commercial interiors, hospitality, lifestyle products, or related industries will be preferred.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Strong relationship\-building and consultative selling abilities.
* A proactive, self\-driven approach with the ability to manage an independent territory.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within your first year, you will:

* Build a strong customer network across your territory.
* Successfully expand Ignite's presence in the commercial fitness market.
* Consistently achieve revenue and business growth targets.
* Become a trusted advisor for gym owners and fitness entrepreneurs.
* Contribute to creating inspiring fitness spaces across your region.

**Why Join Ignite?**

At Ignite, you'll be part of a fast\-growing company that's shaping the future of commercial fitness in India.

Here's what you can expect:

* Competitive fixed salary with attractive performance\-based incentives.
* Opportunity to work with innovative commercial fitness equipment.
* Exposure to premium fitness projects and leading industry clients.
* Structured product and sales training to support your professional growth.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial culture that values ownership and innovation.
* Clear opportunities for career progression into regional and national leadership roles.

**About IndianJournals.com:**  
IndianJournals.com is a leading online aggregator of Indian research publications. We collaborate with numerous publishers to host a diverse array of scholarly content on our platform. Our primary aim is to provide universities, colleges, and their libraries with easy access to high\-quality academic resources.

**Job Description:**  
As a Sales Representative at IndianJournals.com, you will play a pivotal role in expanding our subscriber base within the academic community. Your responsibilities will encompass identifying potential institutions, establishing and nurturing relationships with key stakeholders, and ultimately securing purchase orders. You will be expected to leverage your expertise in scholarly publishing, possess excellent communication skills, and demonstrate a keen ability to analyze data to identify potential subscribers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Negotiation and Closing:** Skillfully negotiate pricing and terms with prospective subscribers to secure purchase orders. Close deals in a timely manner while ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
* Proven track record of success in sales, preferably within the academic publishing industry.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and establish trust with diverse stakeholders.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret sales data and market trends effectively.
* Self\-motivated and results\-oriented, with a proactive approach to identifying and pursuing sales opportunities.
* Willingness to travel extensively to meet with potential subscribers and attend industry events as needed.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary and commission structure.
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

Join IndianJournals.com and be part of a dynamic team dedicated to making a positive impact on academic research and education in India. Apply now to embark on an exciting career in scholarly publishing sales!
