title: Manager, Sales Compensation
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

  

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.  

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365 \- all within 90 seconds.  

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors \- including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.  

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the Role**
------------------


As a Manager, Sales Compensation **(Individual Contributor)**, you’ll play a critical role in scaling and operating the incentive programs that power Rippling’s go\-to\-market organization. Sitting within Accounting and partnering closely with the RevOps team, you’ll help ensure our sales teams are compensated accurately, on time, and in alignment with Rippling’s growth goals.


This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Sales Operations, and Systems, with ownership over commission processing, platform administration, and performance analytics. You’ll be responsible for executing and improving core compensation processes, maintaining data integrity across systems, and building reporting that provides visibility into sales performance and incentive outcomes.


This is a highly quantitative, detail\-oriented role. You’ll be trusted as the subject matter expert for commission calculations and payout mechanics, while also contributing to process improvements and scalable systems as Rippling continues to grow. If you enjoy working with complex data, solving compensation challenges, and supporting fast\-paced sales organizations, this role offers meaningful impact and growth.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Support the design, rollout, and ongoing administration of sales compensation programs, plan documentation, stakeholder communication, and continuous process improvements
* Own end\-to\-end sales commission operations, including monthly and quarterly calculations, validations, reconciliations, accruals, reporting, audit support, and payout preparation, ensuring accuracy and compliance
* Build and maintain dashboards, reporting, and analytical models to track quota attainment, commission payouts, performance trends, and scenario modeling to support incentive strategy and plan updates
* Administer and scale Rippling’s Incentive Compensation Management platform, including compensation plan configuration, calculation logic, reporting automation, user access, and user acceptance testing for new plans and system enhancements
* Partner cross\-functionally with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Accounting, and Systems to ensure data integrity across Salesforce, compensation tools, and reporting layers, and to support close and governance processes
* Manage escalations related to commission payouts and provide clear, data\-backed resolutions

**Please note that this role is based on the EST/PST timezone**
---------------------------------------------------------------

**What You Will Need**
----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years of experience in sales compensation, commissions administration, sales operations, finance, or a related analytical role, preferably in a high\-growth SaaS or technology environment
* Strong proficiency in Salesforce and advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables, nested formulas, and data analysis workflows
* Hands\-on experience with commission management platforms such as CaptivateIQ, Xactly, Everstage, Spiff, or QuotaPath
* Solid understanding of sales compensation structures, quota\-based incentives, revenue crediting methodologies, and payout mechanics
* Exceptional attention to detail and analytical rigor, with the ability to clearly communicate findings to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* High ownership mentality and strong interpersonal skills, with comfort working independently in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments

**Core Competencies**

* Variable compensation administration \& expertise — deep knowledge of commission payout processes, policy, and design
* Data\-driven analysis \& reporting — builds models, audits payouts, and turns attainment data into clear recommendations
* Process building \& scale — designs and implements standardized playbooks, templates, and workflows
* Cross\-functional partnership \& stakeholder management — partners effectively with Sales, RevOps, Finance, and Accounting; manages seller and leader escalations
* Communication \& executive presence — translates complex compensation analysis into slides for leadership

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Portfolio Business Manager - Capco Corporate Services
description:
**Job: Portfolio Business Manager**


**About Us**


*"Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award and has been ranked Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by* *Avtar \& Seramount**. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100\+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.*

***WHY JOIN CAPCO?***



You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.


***MAKE AN IMPACT***



Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.


***\#BEYOURSELFATWORK***



Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.


***CAREER ADVANCEMENT***


*With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.*


***DIVERSITY \& INCLUSION***


*We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.*


**Business Manager: Job Description**



The Business Manager is the engine that turns the business's commercial ambition into action, orchestrating teams across Capco's global organization to align resources, remove barriers and deliver at pace.



This is a senior business leadership role, requiring an executive mindset and the experience, judgement and credibility to operate effectively with senior leaders, navigate complexity, challenge constructively and influence outcomes across teams and geographies, often with limited direct authority.


**Role purpose**



The Business Manager is responsible for ensuring their area of the business \[global client account, capability, or alternative] operates effectively and delivers against its commercial, operational and people objectives.



Working as a trusted partner to the relevant Partner(s), they connect client and sales teams, regional and global leadership, operations and enterprise functions to translate business priorities into coordinated execution.



The Business Manager brings together the right stakeholders, information and decisions at the right time, resolving dependencies, creating accountability and maintaining momentum across a highly collaborative environment.


**Key responsibilities**


* **Stakeholder management \& business orchestration:** Build and actively manage relationships across client and account teams, regional and global leadership, operations and enterprise functions. Navigate competing perspectives and use influence to align stakeholders around shared priorities, remove barriers and drive collective ownership for delivery.
* **Business performance:** Own the management rhythm for the business area, bringing together commercial, financial, operational, resourcing and people information to provide a clear view of performance, identify risks and opportunities, and drive action.
* **Planning \& forecasting:** Lead integrated planning and forecasting across sales, demand, supply, recruitment and financial performance, ensuring assumptions and priorities are aligned across teams.
* **Strategy execution:** Translate global priorities into practical plans, mobilize the relevant teams and maintain momentum and accountability through delivery.
* **Commercial \& client alignment:** Work closely with account and sales teams to understand pipeline, client demand and growth priorities, ensuring these translate into operational and workforce plans.
* **Resourcing \& recruitment:** Connect client demand with workforce supply, skills and recruitment to ensure the business has the right capability and capacity at the right time.
* **Financial management:** Drive financial discipline across the business area, supporting budget management, margin improvement, investment decisions and management of financial risks.
* **People \& talent:** Drive workforce and talent planning, including capacity, attrition, development priorities and succession, working closely with business and people leaders.
* **Business improvement \& operational excellence:** Use data and insight to challenge the status quo, identify opportunities to improve performance and mobilize stakeholders to deliver change. Champion and inform the development of Capco's operational processes and tooling to support broader organizational adoption.


**What success looks like**



A successful Business Manager creates a business that feels joined up rather than siloed, with clear priorities, strong accountability and effective execution.



They ensure that sales ambition, client demand, workforce capacity, financial plans and operational execution are connected, even where delivery requires multiple teams, functions or regions to work together.



Business leaders have a clear view of performance, priorities and emerging risks; stakeholders understand their accountabilities and dependencies; regional and global teams work effectively towards shared goals; and decisions translate into action and measurable outcomes.



Success will be measured against a defined set of KPIs agreed with the relevant business leaders, reflecting the commercial, operational and people priorities of the business area.


***If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.***

title: Industry Solution Leader - Oil, Gas & Chemical (Refining / Chemical Asset Performance)
description:
C3 AI (NYSE: AI), is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end\-to\-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry\-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain\-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: **C3 AI**


C3 AI is seeking an Industry Solution Leader (ISL) for Oil, Gas \& Chemical to lead the design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions for its clients with a specialization in Refining / Chemical Asset Performance.



Industry Solution Leaders combine deep industry and engineering expertise with end\-to\-end ownership of customer solutions. They are expected to understand a customer's operations deeply enough to challenge assumptions, identify and quantify the highest\-value opportunities, define the right technical solution, and lead cross\-functional teams through design, deployment, validation, and scale.



The role combines the responsibilities of a senior domain expert and solution leader. Industry Solution Directors work directly with customer engineering, operations, maintenance, and executive teams while leading C3 AI Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product teams, and other technical resources to deliver measurable business outcomes.



The ideal candidate brings significant hands\-on experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, or maintenance and has the technical judgment, customer leadership, and delivery ownership required to lead complex enterprise AI solutions from problem definition through production.



The ISL, Oil, Gas \& Chemical \- Refining / Chemical Asset Performance should have **hands\-on experience working inside a refinery, chemical plant, or similar continuous\-process facility, including distillation, reactors, furnaces, compressors, heat exchangers, or utilities, with ownership of throughput, yield, energy, APC/process control, or reliability outcomes.**


**RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Own the overall solution strategy, technical direction, and delivery outcomes for assigned customer engagements, maintaining accountability from initial problem definition through production deployment and scale.
* Serve as the primary customer\-facing solution leader and domain expert, developing a detailed understanding of customer operations, equipment, processes, constraints, and business objectives.
* Identify and quantify high\-impact business opportunities across equipment reliability, maintenance, production performance, process optimization, throughput, yield, quality, energy efficiency, and operating economics.
* Translate complex engineering and operational challenges into tractable AI, machine learning, optimization, and software problems with clearly defined requirements, success criteria, and expected business value.
* Lead engagements through use case definition, requirements gathering, solution architecture, application configuration, validation, production deployment, user adoption, and scale\-out.
* Apply deep engineering and industry expertise to challenge assumptions, evaluate technical approaches, interpret analytical results, and ensure solutions are consistent with engineering fundamentals and operational realities.
* Lead cross\-functional teams of Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product managers, engineers, and industry experts, establishing technical priorities and driving alignment around customer outcomes.
* Work directly with customer engineers, operators, reliability teams, maintenance organizations, and executives to validate requirements, solution performance, operational workflows, and business impact.
* Guide the interpretation and use of industrial data, including process signals, equipment attributes, operating states, maintenance history, production information, alarms, quality data, and other engineering information required to solve customer problems.
* Maintain accountability for solution quality, business value, technical risks, delivery progress, customer adoption, and executive communication throughout the engagement.
* Partner with C3 AI product management and engineering teams to identify reusable capabilities, inform product development, and scale successful solutions across assets, production lines, facilities, and business units.
* Support sales teams during opportunity assessment and capture by helping define customer problems, solution approaches, business value, technical requirements, deployment strategy, and demonstrations.
* Support development of statements of work and deployment plans, ensuring scope, deliverables, assumptions, data requirements, risks, timelines, and resource requirements are clearly defined.
* Develop repeatable industry methodologies, solution patterns, and best practices and represent C3 AI in relevant customer, industry, and technical forums.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Industrial, Mining, Metallurgical, Petroleum, Materials, or similar engineering backgrounds are preferred.
* 7\+ years of experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, maintenance, industrial technology, or technically focused consulting.
* Deep experience in one or more asset\-intensive industries, including high\-tech or semiconductor manufacturing, steel and metals, minerals and mining, utilities and power generation, oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, LNG, pharmaceuticals, or heavy manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience solving complex operational problems and improving equipment reliability, production performance, throughput, yield, quality, maintenance effectiveness, energy efficiency, or operating economics.
* Strong understanding of industrial equipment, manufacturing or production processes, process controls, maintenance practices, and operational workflows.
* Experience working with industrial data including sensor and time\-series data, equipment states, alarms, maintenance history, production data, laboratory or quality information, equipment hierarchies, and engineering data.
* Experience with industrial systems such as process historians, SCADA, DCS, MES, EAM/CMMS, ERP, advanced process control, or industrial analytics platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to reason from engineering fundamentals and determine whether analytical and AI\-driven recommendations are physically, technically, and operationally credible.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, customer\-facing technical engagements and working directly with engineering, operational, and executive stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, establish priorities, and drive teams toward practical solutions.
* Ability to work effectively with software engineers, data scientists, product managers, and customer technical teams and translate between domain, business, and technical requirements.
* Excellent presentation, written communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to travel to customer locations as required.


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Experience delivering AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, optimization, predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, process optimization, or industrial digital transformation solutions.
* Hands\-on technical experience working with industrial data, SQL, Python, analytics tools, application configuration, scripting, or similar technologies, with the ability to directly inspect data, prototype analyses, and troubleshoot solution behavior.
* Experience with rotating equipment, electrical equipment, production equipment, manufacturing lines, process units, mining systems, utility assets, or other complex industrial systems.
* Experience taking technical solutions from initial proof of value through production deployment and scale.
* Experience scaling solutions across multiple assets, plants, facilities, or business units.
* Advanced degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical discipline.


**C3 AI provides excellent benefits, a competitive compensation package and generous equity plan.**


C3 AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics, including disabled and veteran status.

title: Business Development Manager, Monetization
description:
Meta is seeking a Business Development Manager to drive monetization strategy and partnership development in the key India market. In this role, you will define and execute high\-impact commercial frameworks that expand Meta's revenue ecosystem across advertising, commerce, and emerging monetization surfaces. You will identify, structure, and close transformative partnerships that unlock new revenue streams, shape product monetization strategy, and influence how Meta's platforms generate sustainable value at scale. This is a role for a experienced business development leader who can operate with full autonomy across complex, ambiguous deal environments and drive company\-level outcomes.  

  

  

### **Business Development Manager, Monetization Responsibilities:**

* Define and lead the long\-term monetization partnership strategy across Meta's advertising, commerce, and platform revenue surfaces
* Identify, evaluate, and execute high\-value strategic partnerships that unlock new monetization opportunities or expand existing revenue streams
* Structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements, including revenue\-sharing arrangements, API monetization deals, and platform licensing frameworks
* Collaborate with product, engineering, legal, and finance teams to align partnership structures with Meta's monetization product roadmap
* Develop and own executive\-level business cases and investment theses for new monetization initiatives, presenting to senior leadership
* Establish frameworks for evaluating partnership ROI, deal economics, and long\-term revenue impact across Meta's monetization portfolio
* Serve as the primary external relationship owner for strategic monetization partners, managing C\-suite and senior stakeholder engagement
* Anticipate market shifts in digital advertising, commerce, and platform monetization to proactively shape Meta's partnership positioning
* Provide strategic guidance to cross\-functional teams on monetization deal structures, market dynamics, and competitive landscape
* Drive organizational alignment on monetization partnership priorities, influencing roadmap decisions and resource allocation across business units

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 12\+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or corporate development with a focus on monetization, advertising, or platform revenue
* Experience structuring and closing complex, multi\-party commercial agreements including revenue\-sharing, licensing, or platform monetization deals
* Track record of defining and executing partnership strategies that have generated measurable, large\-scale revenue impact
* Experience engaging and influencing C\-suite and senior executive stakeholders at partner organizations
* Experience operating independently in ambiguous, high\-stakes deal environments with accountability for company\-level outcomes

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience building and scaling business development functions or establishing new partnership categories from the ground up
* Background in commerce, payments, or emerging platform monetization surfaces such as messaging, AI\-driven experiences, or wearables
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience in digital advertising ecosystem partnerships, including programmatic, performance marketing, or ad tech monetization models
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex deal structures into clear financial models and executive\-ready strategic narratives
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  

  

  

  

  

  

  

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Corporate Strategy Manager (Consulting & Strategy)
description:
**Company Description**  

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**


Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost\-to\-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise\-grade yet easy\-to\-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.  

  

**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

 **Job Description**  

Freshworks is looking for a Manager to join our global Corporate Strategy team and help shape some of the most important decisions facing the company.


This is a high\-impact strategy role for someone who loves solving complex business problems but wants to get closer to the decisions, the executives making them, and the outcomes that follow.


You'll work directly with Strategy leadership and senior executives on questions spanning AI, product strategy, pricing and monetization, GTM growth, market expansion, and strategic investments. One project might involve evaluating how we monetize a new AI capability; another could focus on where Freshworks should invest to accelerate growth or how we evolve our GTM strategy.


The team operates with the rigor of a top strategy consulting firm, but with one important difference: we don't stop at the recommendation. We partner across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to help turn strategy into action and see the impact of the decisions we help shape.

**What You'll Do**

* Own high\-priority strategic initiatives from initial question through recommendation and execution.
* Tackle ambiguous company\-level problems, develop hypotheses, and create the analytical frameworks needed to answer them.
* Evaluate growth opportunities across AI, product, GTM, pricing, market expansion, and strategic investments.
* Build business cases, financial models, market assessments, and scenario analyses that inform investment and resource allocation decisions.
* Partner directly with senior leaders across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to shape decisions and drive alignment.
* Translate strategy into actionable plans and stay close to execution to understand what is working and where we need to adjust.
* Develop executive and Board\-level narratives that distill complex analysis into clear choices and recommendations.
* Bring an outside\-in perspective on the SaaS and AI landscape and help identify the strategic questions Freshworks should be asking next.

 **Qualifications** **What We're Looking For**

* 4\-6\+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a combination of consulting and in\-house strategy experience; **experience from a top\-tier management consulting firm, particularly MBB (Mckinsey, Bain, BCG) is preferred**
* Experience solving growth, product, GTM, pricing, market entry, or investment strategy problems
* Exposure to SaaS, enterprise software, or technology businesses strongly preferred
* Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with the ability to turn data into business insights and recommendations
* Executive\-level communication skills and the ability to influence without authority
* Comfortable moving between high\-level strategy and hands\-on analysis
* Curious, low ego, and energized by ambiguity
* Most importantly, you want to own the outcome, not just deliver the recommendation

**Why This Role**


Freshworks is at an exciting point in its evolution. We're scaling a global SaaS business, expanding our enterprise presence, and navigating how AI changes the products we build, how we monetize them, and how our customers work.


For someone coming from consulting, this is an opportunity to keep the parts of the job you love—complex problems, executive exposure, analytical rigor, and variety—while gaining something that's harder to get as an advisor: ownership.


You'll see the decisions get made. You'll work alongside the teams responsible for executing them. And you'll have the opportunity to see whether the strategy actually worked.


This is a highly visible individual contributor role with exposure to senior executives and the Board, and an opportunity to build a deep understanding of how a global SaaS company operates.

 **Additional Information**  

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: Senior Service Executive
description:
**How you can make an impact**
==============================

You will be responsible for maintaining the accuracy and reliability of pipetting equipment in customer laboratories through professional installation, servicing, calibration, and maintenance.


The role also involves providing technical support to customers across the region and other assigned territories.


* Install, service, maintain and calibrate manual and electronic pipettes at customer sites and service locations.
* Perform functional checks, performance verification and calibration activities in accordance with defined procedures, quality requirements and applicable standards.
* Demonstrate thorough knowledge of pipette operation, features and functionalities, and explain correct usage and care to customers.
* Diagnose technical issues systematically, identify root causes and carry out effective repairs or corrective actions.
* Disassemble and assemble pipettes correctly, ensuring that all components are handled carefully and the instrument is restored to proper working condition.
* Complete service, repair, calibration and verification activities accurately and within the agreed timelines.
* Execute assigned tasks in a systematic manner and meet defined productivity, throughput and quality norms.
* Maintain accurate service records, calibration reports, inspection checklists and other required documentation.
* Report service activities, customer interactions, pending actions and any technical or operational concerns on time.
* Maintain a high level of customer satisfaction by responding professionally, communicating clearly and resolving issues efficiently.
* Evaluate customer requirements and recommend appropriate service, maintenance, calibration or technical support solutions.
* Build a strong understanding of the customer base, laboratory requirements and business environment.
* Support customer visits, product demonstrations, user guidance and basic technical training when required.
* Collaborate with Sales and internal service teams to support customer retention, service opportunities and organizational goals.
* Follow all company policies, safety procedures, quality systems and reporting requirements.
**What sets you apart**
=======================

* Bringing 2–4 years of hands‑on experience in installation, maintenance and servicing of laboratory equipment, ideally in the life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare or research laboratory environment.
* B.E. or B.Tech in Electronics, Biomedical Engineering, Instrumentation, Diploma or a related technical discipline.
* Experience in installing, servicing, maintaining and calibrating pipettes is preferred. Experience with electronic pipettes will be an advantage.
* Basic understanding of pipette operation, functionality, troubleshooting, disassembly, assembly and performance verification.
* A genuine aspiration to learn new products, technologies, service procedures and customer requirements.
* Systematic and disciplined approach to executing assigned work and completing tasks on time.
* Ability to meet defined productivity, throughput, quality and service\-level norms.
* Strong work dedication, punctuality and ownership of service and reporting activities.
* Good analytical and troubleshooting skills, with attention to detail when handling precision instruments.
* Customer\-focused attitude and the ability to maintain positive relationships with laboratory users, lab managers and other stakeholders.
* Ability to understand and evaluate customer requirements and translate them into appropriate technical actions.
* Willingness and ability to travel across Karnataka and to other territories as required.
* Good communication skills in English and the ability to communicate effectively with customers and colleagues. Knowledge of Kannada will be an advantage.
* Basic working knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to maintain accurate service documentation.
* Demonstrated commitment to achieving team and organizational goals.

**What we offer**
=================

* **Purpose and impact.** You help laboratories maintain accurate and reliable pipetting performance, supporting the quality and reproducibility of scientific work.
* **Learning that moves you forward.** You will receive technical training, practical mentoring and on\-the\-job exposure to pipette service, calibration and customer support.
* **Room to grow.** You will build expertise in precision laboratory equipment and have opportunities to develop toward senior technical, specialist or service leadership roles.
* **A customer\-facing career.** You will work directly with laboratories and gain valuable experience in technical problem\-solving, service delivery and customer relationship management.
* **Fair and supportive.** You will work with colleagues who value collaboration, accountability, continuous learning and high\-quality service.

title: Administrative Assistant-EMEA & APJ
description:

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box \- we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

**About the Role**
------------------


The Administrative Assistant provides high\-quality administrative and operational support to the EMEA \& APJ Sales VPship team. The role is responsible for keeping senior leaders organized, on schedule, and focused on their highest priorities.


This is an execution\-focused role centered on calendar management, travel coordination, expense administration, and day\-to\-day logistics. The position reports to the Executive Assistant to the CRO and is not responsible for business strategy, content ownership, or analysis.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Calendar \& Schedule Management**

* Own and manage complex, multi\-time\-zone calendars for EMEA \& APJ Sales VPs.
* Anticipate and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts with minimal disruption.
* Prioritize meeting requests based on leadership priorities, business rhythms, and urgency.
* Coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to schedule meetings efficiently.
* Ensure leaders are well prepared and their schedules remain organized and optimized.

### **Travel Coordination**

* Coordinate end\-to\-end domestic and international travel, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, and visas.
* Develop clear, detailed travel itineraries and travel briefs to minimize friction for leaders.
* Monitor travel plans and proactively manage changes, delays, and disruptions.
* Ensure all travel arrangements comply with company policies and processes.

### **Expense Management**

* Prepare, submit, and track expense reports on behalf of supported leaders.
* Ensure expenses are submitted accurately, promptly, and in accordance with company policies.
* Manage expense\-related follow\-ups, questions, and reconciliations as needed.

### **General Administrative Support**

* Serve as the primary administrative point of contact and liaison for the EMEA \& APJ Sales VPs.
* Manage incoming and outgoing communications, document distribution, and administrative inquiries with professionalism and discretion.
* Maintain well\-organized digital files and ensure accurate record\-keeping of key documents and administrative assets.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and proactively recommend practical solutions.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with a high degree of discretion and sound judgment.

**Scope of the Role**
---------------------


The role is designed to enable senior leaders to focus on business priorities by taking ownership of operational and administrative responsibilities.


The following areas are **out of scope** for this position:

* QBR and Town Hall content, strategy, narratives, or metrics ownership.
* Business analysis, sales reporting, or data interpretation.
* People management or HR responsibilities.
* Budget ownership or financial decision\-making.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* 3\+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or in a similar role supporting senior business leaders.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi\-time\-zone calendars with a high degree of accuracy and prioritization.
* Experience coordinating domestic and international travel and preparing detailed travel itineraries.
* Proficiency with expense management tools and processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with professional fluency.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing attention to detail.
* High level of discretion and sound judgment when handling sensitive or confidential information.
* Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, and Concur or similar expense platforms.

### **Preferred**

* Experience supporting senior leaders within a global or matrixed organization.
* Experience working with stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.
* Familiarity with EMEA business practices and European and Asia\-Pacific working environments.
* Proficiency in one or more additional European or Asia\-Pacific languages.

**About the Team**
------------------


This role is part of a growing Executive and Administrative Assistant function designed to provide scalable, high\-quality support to the company's Vice Presidents.


As the **first EMEA \& APJ\-focused Administrative Assistant**, you will have an opportunity to help establish best practices, shape administrative processes, and define what exceptional administrative support looks like as the team grows.


This is an opportunity for a highly organized, proactive, and detail\-oriented professional to make a meaningful impact by enabling senior leaders to operate efficiently across regions and time zones.

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high\-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.


### **The Culture Memo: Our Operating System**



Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high\-intensity, mission\-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.


* **Extreme Ownership:** We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

### **The Perks \& Ownership:**



We want our team to feel like owners because they **are** owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.


* **Meaningful Equity:** Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren’t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.

**The Role: Staff Engineer**
We’re looking for a Staff Engineer who lives for solving *the hard stuff*. You’ll be the technical force multiplier—leading architecture, scaling systems, and guiding engineers to build products that help predict and prevent cyber breaches **before** they happen.

title: Senior Systems Architect
description:
Mavenir is building the future of networks and pioneering advanced technology, focusing on the vision of a single, software\-based automated network that runs on any cloud. As the industry's only end\-to\-end, cloud\-native network software provider, Mavenir is transforming the way the world connects, accelerating software network transformation for 250\+ Communications Service Providers in over 120 countries, which serve more than 50% of the world’s subscribers.

**Role Summary**


Mavenir is looking for a passionate and self\-directed senior systems engineer within its Mobile Networking division to specify and drive development of virtualized mobile core products based on its innovative virtualized platform. The ideal candidate will have a strong background architecting and specifying requirements for 3GPP based products, familiarity with NFV standards \& ecosystem and passion for influencing development for a disruptive product and solution in a competitive marketplace.
  

The Senior Systems Engineer will be expected to innovate and think out of the box on a regular basis leveraging an innovative virtualized platform for telco applications, enhanced with Mavenir intellectual property at the intersection of virtualization, mobile networking, and data analytics.**Key Responsibilities**

* Define the overall architecture, external interfaces and detailed functional description of the solution
* Perform technical evaluations of major system enhancements and major new customer requirements
* Create detailed system level functional requirements and specifications
* Monitor standards body activities to and participate (if necessary) to influence the industry with innovative vision of the company
* Identify opportunities for innovation and market disruption.
* Provide active support for, product management, pre\-sales and marketing activities including technical solutions support in the RFI/RFP response.
* Provide system level technical support in customer meetings
* Work closely with engineering and QA teams to drive the timely and quality release of new products and features
* Provide guidance and leadership to junior members of the team

**Job Requirements**

* Good knowledge of 5G NFs like SMF/UPF/AMF
* Knowledge of other 5G NFs is an added advantage
* Working knowledge of SGW/PGW/MME
* Possess sound understanding of essential elements of Systems engineering including how to convey requirements to development and QA teams
* In\-depth knowledge on mobile networks, especially on LTE standards in core network and the interface between radio network and core network. Additional knowledge on the RAN standards is a plus.
* Familiarity with NFV standards and ecosystem.
* Excellent inter\-personal and leadership skills.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent presentation skills for a variety of audiences including executives, partners, and customers.
* Ability to quickly grasp and adapt to new technologies and concepts.

We make bold moves together and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career, our culture will embrace you.

**Job Description**  

HPE’s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company’s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build **HPE Networking**, with the ambition of creating the **best networking business on the planet**. This role sits at the center of that effort as part of **the Lead\-to\-Cash (L2C) program**, responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a **single platform**, replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.


As part of a fast\-moving, **multi\-year transformation**, the team will stabilize near\-term operations, **migrate core** **platforms, onboard****businesses****and suppliers globally**, and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business operates for years to come. You will work closely with**business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders** on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.


For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help**build a new business unit from its earliest days**, rather than inherit someone else’s systems. You will gain **hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-scale platform integration and cross\-functional program leadership**, with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.

**Workstream\-Specific Details**

*\[ Placeholder – to be completed by Workstream**Lead ]*

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end implementation, configuration, enhancement, and production support of Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) systems.
* Own and manage RAR system capabilities supporting revenue accounting, revenue recognition, contract accounting, performance obligations, revenue allocation, deferrals, accruals, adjustments, and revenue reporting.
* Partner with the Finance Solution Architect to design and optimize RAR solutions aligned with business requirements, Finance strategy, and enterprise architecture.
* Collaborate with Revenue Accounting, Corporate Accounting, Sales, Order Management, Billing, CPQ, Tax, Legal, IT, and other cross\-functional teams to gather requirements and develop effective system solutions.
* Design and configure SAP RAR solutions to support complex revenue accounting and recognition requirements.
* Ensure RAR solutions comply with IFRS 15, ASC 606, applicable accounting policies, SOX, and internal control requirements.
* Support complex revenue scenarios including multiple performance obligations, contract modifications, variable consideration, standalone selling price allocation, contract assets, contract liabilities, revenue deferrals, and adjustments.
* Manage integrations between RAR and SAP S/4HANA Finance, SD, Billing, Order Management, CPQ, CRM, Contract Management, Tax, and third\-party applications.

Ensure accurate and reliable data flow from sales/order contract billing RAR General Ledger* financial reporting.
* Lead system testing activities including SIT, UAT, integration testing, regression testing, and release validation.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex production issues impacting Revenue Accounting and Reporting.
* Perform root\-cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions for recurring system and revenue accounting issues.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and year\-end revenue close and reporting activities.
* Partner with Finance and Accounting teams to investigate and resolve revenue reconciliation issues between source systems, billing, RAR, subledger, and General Ledger.
* Ensure system changes comply with SOX, internal controls, audit requirements, security policies, and change management standards.
* Support internal and external audits by providing system documentation, configuration details, control evidence, and remediation support.
* Develop and maintain documentation covering system configuration, revenue accounting rules, business processes, integrations, testing, controls, and operational procedures.
* Provide user training, guidance, and subject matter expertise to Finance and Revenue Accounting teams.
* Drive continuous improvement and standardization of RAR processes and system capabilities across business units and regions.
* Identify opportunities for automation, workflow optimization, reconciliation automation, reporting improvements, and reduction of manual Finance activities.
* Monitor SAP product releases, accounting standard changes, regulatory requirements, and industry trends and recommend appropriate system enhancements.
* Lead adoption of new SAP RAR capabilities and industry best practices.
* Work with application support teams and implementation partners to establish effective L1/L2/L3 support, knowledge management, monitoring, and operational governance.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to Finance systems analysts, support teams, and external partners.
* Support strategic Finance transformation initiatives involving RAR modernization, SAP S/4HANA, process standardization, automation, and Finance technology simplification.
**Education And Experience Required**

* 10–14 years of relevant experience in Finance Systems, SAP, or enterprise Finance technology.
* 4–6\+ years of hands\-on experience with SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR).
**Knowledge And Skills**

* Extensive experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance and Revenue Accounting and Reporting.
* Strong understanding of Revenue Recognition principles, including IFRS 15 and ASC 606\.
* Deep knowledge of revenue accounting concepts including performance obligations, transaction price, variable consideration, standalone selling price, revenue allocation, contract assets and liabilities, deferrals, accruals, and contract modifications.
* Proven experience implementing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting SAP RAR in a large enterprise environment.
* Strong experience integrating RAR with SAP SD, FI, Billing, Order Management, CPQ, CRM, and third\-party applications.
* Strong understanding of Order\-to\-Cash / Quote\-to\-Cash processes and their impact on Revenue Accounting.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end revenue data flows from transaction through billing, RAR, General Ledger, and financial reporting.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP configuration, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Strong experience with revenue reconciliation and financial close processes.
* Experience supporting complex global revenue models and regional accounting requirements.
* Strong understanding of SOX, internal controls, audit requirements, and Finance compliance.
* Proven experience in incident, problem, change, and release management for business\-critical Finance applications.
* Experience leading Finance systems transformation, enhancements, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Knowledge of Finance automation, workflow, analytics, and digital transformation is desirable.
* Proven ability to design and deliver complex, integrated Finance solutions at enterprise scale.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively with Finance, Accounting, Business, IT, Architecture, and external partners.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong relationship management, project management, and process development skills.
* Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment in complex business and technology environments.

title: Seller Manager II, Project Tez
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We are seeking a talented, dedicated, and highly analytical Seller Manager to drive selection and in\-stock for Amazon sellers. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role on an important initiative at Amazon. This position requires a candidate with proven analytical skills with experience driving process improvement, thought leadership, and delivering results.  

The Seller Manager will be responsible for executing inventory strategies on behalf of sellers to optimize customer experience, sales, margin and turns. They will be relentlessly focused on delivering high in\-stock rates for sellers in order to meet the needs of our customers. They will dive deep into core drivers of in\-stock performance for sellers, and proactively identify opportunities to improve tools and workflows. This role interacts closely with retail and operations business partners across Amazon, and is pivotal to the growth of this strategic initiative.  

The successful candidate will communicate effectively across teams and levels, while balancing the needs and requirements of internal and external customers. Flexibility and the ability to prioritize in a changing business environment will also be key. Our team culture is goal\-oriented, collaborative and driven to achieve results. We seek an individual who is motivated by a fast\-paced and highly entrepreneurial environment who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get things done.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Maintain excellent in\-stock rates for sellers across owned category and/or region  

Execute inventory strategies on behalf of sellers to optimize sales, turns, and inventory health  

Monitor, analyze and own key performance indicators such as in\-stock rate, procurement lead time (PLT), fill rate, forecast accuracy and days of cover (DOC)  

Forecast and manage efficient inbound and outbound inventory flows and health for sellers, including forecasting, purchasing, and removing unproductive inventory  

Drive root cause analysis/reporting on operational issues, develop action plans and project manage improvements with the ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously  

Work with internal teams collaboratively, to help drive tools and process improvements that affect purchasing and procurement workflows, with emphasis on automating tasks that are currently performed manually

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* MBA
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers

----------------------------

* Experience influencing C\-level executives
